name: KoratFlow — Escuchar al Lead (v2 — con respondido_at + Auto-Kill)

_meta.description: v2 of Escuchar al Lead. Improvements: 1) Records respondido_at timestamp for heat map analytics. 2) Calculates response_time_minutes for conversion stats. 3) AUTO-KILL: if lead was queued, sets automation_status=cancelled and clears scheduled_at so no future batch sends fire.
_meta.importantNotes: Replace {{ $env.SUPABASE_ANON_KEY }} with your actual Supabase anon key or set it as an n8n environment variable.
